_comment: Stop runs .claude/hooks/stop-check.sh, which blocks once and reports without blocking on the retry; see the script's header.

hooks.command: sed -n '/^## Current goal/,/^## /p' ROADMAP.md | sed '$d'; echo; tail -n 5 DECISIONS.md
[ -f package.json ] || exit 0; jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | xargs pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level silent
